items.headline: Eagles, already depleted at RB, lose Will Shipley to foot injury
items.description: Eagles running back Will Shipley has been ruled out of Sunday's game against the Jaguars with a foot injury.

items.headline: NFL Week 5 arrivals: Maxx Crosby, Craig Woodson honor New England legends
items.description: NFL stars continue to turn game-day arrivals into their own weekly fashion showcase.

items.headline: Jeremiah Trotter Jr., Bryan Thomas Jr. ejected for fighting
items.description: Eagles linebacker Jeremiah Trotter Jr. and Jaguars defensive end Bryan Thomas Jr. were ejected after getting into a fight on the opening kickoff at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.

items.headline: Sources: Eagles mull Lane Johnson roster status amid O-line changes
items.description: Lane Johnson is expected to remain on the Eagles' 53-man roster until after June 1 for salary cap purposes as Philadelphia continues to navigate multiple changes to the offensive line.

items.headline: Eagles vs. Jaguars, NFL London preview: ESPN experts on key players, matchups and predictions
items.description: The NFL rolls into London this begin with a clash between the Indianapolis Colts and the Washington Commanders -- so we asked ESPN reporters Stephen Holder and John Keim for a preview.

items.headline: Sources: Ravens held Cam Jurgens physical before trade with Eagles
items.description: As the Ravens and Eagles were preparing to agree to a trade that would send Cam Jurgens to Baltimore, the two sides made immediate plans for the center to undergo a physical in Philadelphia before any deal was finalized, league sources told ESPN.
